description: Test suite for the 'Company' doctype in ERPNext, including unit tests for chart of accounts creation based on existing company and country templates, as well as utility functions for creating companies, leads, and communications.

classes.name: TestCompany
classes.description: Unit test class for testing company-related functionalities in ERPNext.

methods.name: test_coa_based_on_existing_company
methods.description: Tests creation of chart of accounts based on an existing company.

methods.name: test_coa_based_on_country_template
methods.description: Tests creation of companies based on country-specific chart templates.

methods.name: delete_mode_of_payment
methods.description: Deletes mode of payment entries for a given company.

methods.name: create_company_communication
methods.description: Creates a communication record linked to a doctype and document name.

methods.name: create_child_company
methods.description: Creates a child company record if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_test_lead_in_company
methods.description: Creates or updates a lead associated with a specified company.
